_about: Sources shown at the bottom of a guide (scripts/build_sources.py writes them). Add only links you have opened and that really cover the topic. 'used_for' says what the page covers, never more. Run 'python3 scripts/build_sources.py --verify' before changing 'checked': it must only move forward after the links were re-checked. skip_verify marks sites that block scripted requests (CRTC, Canada.ca, CDC, some others): the URL came from a web search, so open it in a browser to re-check it. kind: maker (makers and providers), authority (health and medical organizations), independent (reviews and testing), official (government sources and programs).
